code='''def transform(grid):
    from collections import deque
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=max(set(v for row in grid for v in row), key=lambda x: sum(r.count(x) for r in grid))
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); seen=set()
    for y in range(h):
        for x in range(w):
            c=grid[y][x]
            if c==bg or (y,x) in seen: continue
            cells=[(y,x)]; seen.add((y,x))
            while cells:
                a,b=cells.pop()
                for da,db in ((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                    na,nb=a+da,b+db
                    if 0<=na<h and 0<=nb<w and (na,nb) not in seen and grid[na][nb]==c:
                        seen.add((na,nb));cells.append((na,nb))
            y0=min(a for a,b in seen if grid[a][b]==c); y1=max(a for a,b in seen if grid[a][b]==c)
            x0=min(b for a,b in seen if grid[a][b]==c); x1=max(b for a,b in seen if grid[a][b]==c)
            fill=2 if (y1-y0+1)%2==0 else 7
            for a in range(y0+1,y1):
                for b in range(x0+1,x1): out[a][b]=fill
    return out
'''
# better component bounds due seen global incl same-color separate; compute components correctly
code=code.replace("cells=[(y,x)]; seen.add((y,x))\n            while cells:","cells=[(y,x)]; seen.add((y,x)); comp=[(y,x)]\n            while cells:").replace("seen.add((na,nb));cells.append((na,nb))\n            y0=min(a for a,b in seen if grid[a][b]==c); y1=max(a for a,b in seen if grid[a][b]==c)\n            x0=min(b for a,b in seen if grid[a][b]==c); x1=max(b for a,b in seen if grid[a][b]==c)","seen.add((na,nb));cells.append((na,nb));comp.append((na,nb))\n            y0=min(a for a,b in comp); y1=max(a for a,b in comp)\n            x0=min(b for a,b in comp); x1=max(b for a,b in comp)")
ns={};exec(code,ns); transform=ns['transform']
out=transform(rows)
print([len(r) for r in out])
print(json.dumps({'action':'submit','grid':out},separators=(',',':')))
